subject: Startups
title: Founder Vesting
description: Learn Founder Vesting in one minute.

hook.text: Two friends start a company 50-50. One quits after three months but keeps half the equity.

buildup.text: Vesting protects against early departures: shares are earned over time, typically four years with a one-year cliff.

discovery.text: With a one-year cliff, a departing founder gets nothing if they leave in the first year.

twist.text: Even co-founders should vest. Investors require it. Without vesting, a departed co-founder holds the company hostage.

climax.text: Vesting aligns incentives with time invested. It ensures that equity goes to people who build, not those who leave.

punchline.text: Vest everyone—including yourself. It protects the company.

quiz.question: What is a typical vesting schedule for startup founders?
options: Four years with a one-year cliff
